newsitem.title: CANADA: Antares raises stake in Rappa Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Antares raises stake in Rappa Holdings.

text.p: Antares Mining & Exploration Corp said on Tuesday that it has agreed to raise its stake in South African-based Rappa Holdings (Proprietary) Ltd to 50 percent from 24.75 percent.
Antares Mining said in a statement it has signed an agreement with a subsidiary of The Standard Bank of South Africa Ltd.

The purchase price includes a cash payment of C$3.7 million, the refinancing of C$1.2 million of subordinated debt and 2.179 million Antares common shares. Antares said it may further increase its stake in Rappa Holdings.
"Negotiations are proceeding with the objective of Antares further increasing its Rappa ownership," Antares said.
Rappa's cash flow is expected to exceed C$10 million during the year ended March 31, 1998 from the recovery of about 100,000 ounces of gold.
"The expansion of Rappa's unique recovery technology to base and alloying metals should further enhance cash flow," Antares said.
